set -Eeuo pipefail
APP=/srv/lowcost-europa
ACCOUNT=le001_1789265592
echo 'BACKEND_AUDIT=begin'
test -d "$APP" && test -x "$APP/.venv/bin/python"
sha="$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD)"
test -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)"
printf 'GIT_SHA=%s\nGIT_WORKTREE=clean\n' "$sha"
sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" "$APP/.venv/bin/python" - "$APP" <<'PY'
import ast,pathlib,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
files=[x.decode() for x in subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(root),"ls-files","-z"]).split(b"\0") if x]
py=[p for p in files if p.endswith(".py")]
js=[p for p in files if p.endswith(".js")]
html=[p for p in files if p.endswith(".html")]
sections={"models":0,"views":0,"urls":0,"tests":0,"services":0,"migrations":0}
stats={"functions":0,"classes":0,"imports":0}
errors=[]
for rel in py:
  key=rel.lower()
  for sect in sections:
    if sect in key: sections[sect]+=1
  try:
    tree=ast.parse((root/rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"),filename=rel)
    stats["functions"]+=sum(isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) for n in ast.walk(tree))
    stats["classes"]+=sum(isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) for n in ast.walk(tree))
    stats["imports"]+=sum(isinstance(n,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom)) for n in ast.walk(tree))
  except (SyntaxError,UnicodeError,OSError) as e:errors.append((rel,type(e).__name__))
for name,n in [("TRACKED_FILES",len(files)),("PYTHON_FILES",len(py)),("JS_FILES",len(js)),("TEMPLATE_FILES",len(html)),("AST_ERRORS",len(errors))]:
  print(name+"="+str(n))
for d in (sections,stats):
  for key,n in d.items(): print("PY_"+key.upper()+"="+str(n))
for name,reason in errors[:5]:print("AST_ERROR="+name+";TYPE="+reason)
if errors:sys.exit(15)
print("ALL_PYTHON_AST_PARSED=pass")
PY
app_manage() {
  sudo -n bash -c '
    set -a
    . /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env
    set +a
    export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.production
    cd /srv/lowcost-europa
    runuser -u le001_1789265592 -- .venv/bin/python manage.py "$@"
  ' bash "$@"
}
app_manage check >/dev/null 2>&1
echo 'DJANGO_CHECK=pass'
app_manage check --deploy >/dev/null 2>&1
echo 'DJANGO_DEPLOY_CHECK=pass'
app_manage makemigrations --check --dry-run >/dev/null 2>&1
echo 'DJANGO_MIGRATION_CHECK=pass'
app_manage shell -c '
from datetime import timedelta
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone
from django.conf import settings
from apps.catalog.models import Offer,OfferCandidate,ProductFamily,ExternalMetricsSnapshot
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q
from apps.catalog.services.weekly_discovery import PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY
now=timezone.now()
assert settings.DEBUG is False and settings.PUBLIC_INDEXING_ENABLED is False
families=list(ProductFamily.objects.exclude(status=ProductFamily.Status.RETIRED).order_by("display_order","name","pk"))
eligible=Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q(now),is_active=True,owner_hidden=False,family_placements__product_family__in=families).distinct()
print("FAMILIES="+str(len(families)))
print("ELIGIBLE_OFFERS="+str(eligible.count()))
print("ORIGIN_UNPROVEN="+str(eligible.filter(Q(ship_from_country__isnull=True)|Q(ship_from_verified_at__isnull=True)).count()))
for f in families:
 n=OfferCandidate.objects.filter(product_family=f,status=OfferCandidate.Status.PENDING).count()
 print("QUEUE="+f.slug+";PENDING="+str(n)+";PAUSED="+str(int(n>=PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY)))
for source in ("ALIEXPRESS","META"):
 snap=ExternalMetricsSnapshot.objects.filter(source=source).first()
 state="missing" if snap is None else ("fresh" if snap.checked_at<=now and now-snap.checked_at<=timedelta(hours=12) else "stale")
 print("STORED_"+source+"_METRICS="+state)
print("DJANGO_DATABASE_READ=pass")
'
echo 'BACKEND_AUDIT=pass'
